description: Windkraftanlagen Saarland is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
